AURORAMOD-AURORA_STRIKE.title: Strike
AURORAMOD-AURORA_DEFEND.title: Defend
AURORAMOD-AURORA_REACTOR_WAKE.title: Reactor Wake
AURORAMOD-AURORA_TACTICAL_CONVERGENCE.de:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
[gold]Cold / Warm / Overload[/gold]: gain {HeatPower} / gain {WarmHeat} / [gold]Vent[/gold] {HeatPower} [gold]Heat[/gold], respectively.
AURORAMOD-AURORA_SYSTEM_CRASH.title: System Crash
AURORAMOD-AURORA_SYSTEM_CRASH.descriptio:
Unplayable.
In [gold]hand[/gold]: Attacks deal 25% less damage (does not stack).
AURORAMOD-AURORA_BREACHING_THRUST.title: Breaching Thrust
AURORAMOD-AURORA_SIDESTEP.title: Sidestep
AURORAMOD-AURORA_SEARING_CUT.title: Searing Cut
AURORAMOD-AURORA_SEARING_CUT.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage; if the target intends to attack, gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
Gain {HeatPower:diff()} [gold]Heat[/gold].
AURORAMOD-AURORA_DEPLOY_BLADE.title: Deploy: Blade
AURORAMOD-AURORA_DEPLOY_BLADE.descriptio: [gold]Deploy[/gold] an [gold]Attack Module[/gold] whose end-of-turn damage is {ModuleValue:diff()}.
AURORAMOD-AURORA_MELTDOWN_SLASH.title: Meltdown Slash
AURORAMOD-AURORA_MELTDOWN_SLASH.descript:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
[gold]Overload[/gold]: deal it twice and immediately trigger [gold]Overheat[/gold].
AURORAMOD-AURORA_CROSSFIRE.title: Crossfire
AURORAMOD-AURORA_CROSSFIRE.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies and trigger all Attack [gold]Modules[/gold] once.
Gain {HeatPower:diff()} [gold]Heat[/gold].
AURORAMOD-AURORA_EJECT_CORE.title: Eject Core
AURORAMOD-AURORA_EJECT_CORE.description:
[gold]Vent[/gold] all [gold]Heat[/gold].
With a [gold]Module[/gold]: give the lowest-value one [gold]Enhancement[/gold] equal to [gold]Heat[/gold] actually Vented (max 8).{IfUpgraded:choose(0):| Trigger all [gold]Modules[/gold] once.}
AURORAMOD-AURORA_ATTACK_MODULE_TOKEN.des:
End of turn: deal {Value} damage to your highest-[gold]Lock[/gold] enemy (random on ties or no Lock).
Choose this card to replace the [gold]Module[/gold].
AURORAMOD-AURORA_SHIELD_MODULE_TOKEN.des: At the start of your turn, this [gold]Module[/gold] grants {Value} [gold]Block[/gold]. Choose this card to replace the [gold]Module[/gold].
AURORAMOD-AURORA_DEPLOY_BULWARK.title: Deploy: Bulwark
AURORAMOD-AURORA_DEPLOY_BULWARK.descript: [gold]Deploy[/gold] a [gold]Shield Module[/gold] whose start-of-turn [gold]Block[/gold] is {ModuleValue}.{IfUpgraded:choose(0):| Then trigger the new module once.}
AURORAMOD-AURORA_TARGET_PAINTER.title: Target Painter
AURORAMOD-AURORA_VENT_SHIELD.title: Vent Shield
AURORAMOD-AURORA_VENT_SHIELD.description: Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold] and [gold]Vent[/gold] {VentMax} [gold]Heat[/gold]; gain {BlockPerHeat} more Block per Heat actually Vented.
AURORAMOD-AURORA_LINKED_DEFENSE.title: Linked Defense
AURORAMOD-AURORA_LINKED_DEFENSE.descript:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold] and trigger all Shield [gold]Modules[/gold] once.
[gold]Cold[/gold]: trigger them again.
AURORAMOD-AURORA_AUXILIARY_HARDPOINT.des:
This combat, gain 1 [gold]Module slot[/gold] (max 3).
Choose to deploy an [gold]Attack Module[/gold] or [gold]Shield Module[/gold].
AURORAMOD-AURORA_ABLATING_SHELL.title: Ablating Shell
AURORAMOD-AURORA_ABLATING_SHELL.descript: Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold]. [gold]Cold[/gold] or [gold]Warm[/gold]: instead gain {ChargedBlock:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold], then gain {HeatPower} [gold]Heat[/gold].
AURORAMOD-AURORA_PROVOCATION.title: Provocation
AURORAMOD-AURORA_PROVOCATION.description: Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold] and apply {ProtocolStacks} [gold]Challenge Protocol[/gold]; gain {MomentumPerStack} [gold]Momentum[/gold] per stack actually added.
AURORAMOD-AURORA_FIELD_MAINTENANCE.title: Field Maintenance
AURORAMOD-AURORA_FIELD_MAINTENANCE.descr:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
With a [gold]Module[/gold]: give {ModuleEnhancement:diff()} [gold]Enhancement[/gold] to the least-enhanced one.
AURORAMOD-AURORA_VALIDATION_LOOP.title: Validation Loop
AURORAMOD-AURORA_CHALLENGE_RIPOSTE.title: Challenge Riposte
AURORAMOD-AURORA_CHALLENGE_RIPOSTE.descr:
Remove all your [gold]Challenge Protocol[/gold] from the target.
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage; per stack actually removed, +{DamagePerStack:diff()} damage and [gold]Vent[/gold] {VentPerStack} [gold]Heat[/gold].
AURORAMOD-AURORA_PARALLEL_PROCESSING.des:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold] and [gold]Scan[/gold] {ScanCount}; gain {BlockPerMoved:diff()} more per card actually moved.
[gold]Chained[/gold]: draw {DrawCount} cards.
AURORAMOD-AURORA_REACTOR_THRUST.title: Reactor Thrust
AURORAMOD-AURORA_REACTOR_THRUST.descript:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. If gaining {HeatPower} [gold]Heat[/gold] would trigger [gold]Overheat[/gold], first gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
Gain {HeatPower} [gold]Heat[/gold].
AURORAMOD-AURORA_ADAPTIVE_ARC.title: Adaptive Arc
AURORAMOD-AURORA_ADAPTIVE_ARC.descriptio:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Target intends to attack: apply {WeakPower} [gold]Weak[/gold]; otherwise apply {LockStacks} [gold]Lock[/gold].
AURORAMOD-AURORA_RAPID_COMMAND.title: Rapid Command
AURORAMOD-AURORA_RAPID_COMMAND.descripti:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Rightmost in [gold]hand[/gold] when played: instead deal {RightDamage:diff()} and gain {HeatPower} [gold]Heat[/gold].
AURORAMOD-AURORA_THERMAL_SWEEP.title: Thermal Sweep
AURORAMOD-AURORA_THERMAL_SWEEP.descripti:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies.
[gold]Cold[/gold]: gain {HeatGain} [gold]Heat[/gold]. [gold]Overload[/gold]: [gold]Vent[/gold] {VentMax} [gold]Heat[/gold].
AURORAMOD-AURORA_PROTOCOL_BREAKER.title: Protocol Breaker
AURORAMOD-AURORA_PROTOCOL_BREAKER.descri:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Remove {ProtocolConsumed} [gold]Challenge Protocol[/gold] you applied to the target; if actually removed, gain {MomentumGain} [gold]Momentum[/gold].
AURORAMOD-AURORA_SYNCHRONIZE.title: Synchronize
AURORAMOD-AURORA_SYNCHRONIZE.description: Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold]. Choose a [gold]Module[/gold] and trigger it twice.
AURORAMOD-AURORA_TEMPERED_BY_HEAT.title: Tempered by Heat
AURORAMOD-AURORA_GUARDED_FOCUS.title: Guarded Focus
AURORAMOD-AURORA_GUARDED_FOCUS.descripti:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
No Attack played this turn: gain {MomentumGain:diff()} [gold]Momentum[/gold]; in [gold]Warm[/gold], gain {WarmMomentum:diff()} instead.
AURORAMOD-AURORA_FLUX_BLADE.title: Flux Blade
AURORAMOD-AURORA_FLUX_BLADE.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
At resolution start: [gold]Cold[/gold] — gain {HeatStep:diff()} [gold]Heat[/gold]; [gold]Warm[/gold] — gain {MomentumGain} [gold]Momentum[/gold]; [gold]Overload[/gold] — [gold]Vent[/gold] {HeatStep:diff()} [gold]Heat[/gold].
AURORAMOD-AURORA_CHAINED_GUARD.title: Chained Guard
AURORAMOD-AURORA_CHAINED_GUARD.descripti: Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold]. [gold]Chained[/gold]: instead gain {ChainedBlock:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold], then [gold]Vent[/gold] up to {VentMax:diff()} [gold]Heat[/gold].
AURORAMOD-AURORA_SEQUENCE_STRIKE.title: Sequence Strike
AURORAMOD-AURORA_SEQUENCE_STRIKE.descrip:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
[gold]Chained[/gold]: instead deal {ChainedDamage:diff()} × {HitCount:diff()}; if also [gold]Cold[/gold], gain {HeatPower:diff()} [gold]Heat[/gold].
AURORAMOD-AURORA_COUNTERMEASURE.title: Countermeasure
AURORAMOD-AURORA_COUNTERMEASURE.descript:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. Apply {ProtocolStacks} [gold]Challenge Protocol[/gold].
Target already had your [gold]Challenge Protocol[/gold]: gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold] and {MomentumGain} [gold]Momentum[/gold].
AURORAMOD-AURORA_FINE_TUNING.title: Fine Tuning
AURORAMOD-AURORA_GAIN_HEAT_TOKEN.title: Gain Heat
AURORAMOD-AURORA_VENT_HEAT_TOKEN.title: Vent Heat
AURORAMOD-AURORA_RED_ZONE_DIVE.title: Red-Zone Dive
AURORAMOD-AURORA_BURNING_ADVANCE.title: Burning Advance
AURORAMOD-AURORA_BURNING_ADVANCE.descrip:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage and gain {HeatPower} [gold]Heat[/gold].
First zone change it causes each turn: return it to your [gold]hand[/gold]; this turn, it costs {ReturnCost} and [gold]Exhausts[/gold] after its next play.
AURORAMOD-AURORA_REACTOR_PILEDRIVER.desc: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. After you [gold]Overheat[/gold] this combat, this card costs no more than {DiscountCost}.
AURORAMOD-AURORA_CORE_SPLITTER.title: Core Splitter
AURORAMOD-AURORA_CORE_SPLITTER.descripti:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Next [gold]Overheat[/gold] damage at least {OverheatThreshold}: deal it {HitCount} times instead.
AURORAMOD-AURORA_ABLATIVE_ARMOR.title: Ablative Armor
AURORAMOD-AURORA_RESIDUAL_ARMOR.title: Residual Armor
AURORAMOD-AURORA_RESIDUAL_ARMOR.descript: The first time you [gold]Overheat[/gold] each turn, gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold] before taking [gold]Overheat[/gold] damage.
AURORAMOD-AURORA_RESIDUAL_ARMOR.smartDes: The first time you Overheat each turn, gain {Block} Block before taking Overheat damage.
AURORAMOD-AURORA_PHASE_CUTTER.title: Phase Cutter
AURORAMOD-AURORA_PHASE_CUTTER.descriptio: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. [gold]Cold[/gold]: apply {WeakPower} [gold]Weak[/gold]; [gold]Warm[/gold]: apply {LockStacks} [gold]Lock[/gold]; [gold]Overload[/gold]: [gold]Vent[/gold] up to {VentMax} [gold]Heat[/gold].
AURORAMOD-AURORA_THERMODYNAMIC_CONVERSIO:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold] and [gold]Vent[/gold] {VentMax} [gold]Heat[/gold].
Gain {BlockPerHeat} more [gold]Block[/gold] per Heat actually Vented; if exactly {VentMax}, gain {EnergyGain} Energy.
AURORAMOD-AURORA_ZONE_CALIBRATION.title: Zone Calibration
AURORAMOD-AURORA_PRECISION_VENT.title: Precision Vent
AURORAMOD-AURORA_PHASE_SHIELD.title: Phase Shield
AURORAMOD-AURORA_PHASE_SHIELD.descriptio: The first time you change [gold]Heat[/gold] zones each turn, gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
AURORAMOD-AURORA_PHASE_SHIELD.smartDescr: The first time you change Heat zones each turn, gain {Block} Block.
AURORAMOD-AURORA_COOLING_CYCLE.title: Cooling Cycle
AURORAMOD-AURORA_COOLING_CYCLE.descripti: The first time you actually [gold]Vent[/gold] [gold]Heat[/gold] each turn, draw {DrawCount} card.{IfUpgraded:choose(0):| Gain {TriggerBlock:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].}
AURORAMOD-AURORA_COOLING_CYCLE.smartDesc: The first time you actually Vent Heat each turn, draw {DrawCount} cards and gain {TriggerBlock} Block.
AURORAMOD-AURORA_GATHER_EDGE.title: Gather Edge
AURORAMOD-AURORA_CHARGING_STANCE.title: Overload Engine
AURORAMOD-AURORA_CHARGING_STANCE.descrip: For the rest of combat, whenever you play an Attack, gain {HeatPerAttack} [gold]Heat[/gold].
AURORAMOD-AURORA_EDGEGUARD.title: Edgeguard
AURORAMOD-AURORA_EDGEGUARD.description: Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold], plus Block equal to your [gold]Momentum[/gold] (max +{MomentumBlockCap:diff()}).
AURORAMOD-AURORA_DELAYED_SWEEP.title: Delayed Sweep
AURORAMOD-AURORA_DELAYED_SWEEP.descripti: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies, plus 1 per {MomentumPerDamage} [gold]Momentum[/gold] (max +{MomentumDamageCap:diff()}).
AURORAMOD-AURORA_HEAT_FED_FOCUS.title: Heat-fed Focus
AURORAMOD-AURORA_HEAT_FED_FOCUS.descript:
[gold]Vent[/gold] {VentMax:diff()} [gold]Heat[/gold]; gain {MomentumPerHeat} [gold]Momentum[/gold] per Heat actually Vented.
If this drops you from [gold]Overload[/gold] to [gold]Warm[/gold], gain {DropBonus:diff()} more.
AURORAMOD-AURORA_OVERLOAD_PROTOCOL.title: Overload Protocol
AURORAMOD-AURORA_OVERLOAD_PROTOCOL.descr: Draw {DrawCount} cards. [gold]Chained[/gold]: draw {ChainedDraw:diff()} more and gain {HeatGain} [gold]Heat[/gold].
AURORAMOD-AURORA_STEP_SLASH.title: Step Slash
AURORAMOD-AURORA_BROADCAST_SLASH.title: Broadcast Slash
AURORAMOD-AURORA_BROADCAST_SLASH.descrip: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies. [gold]Chained[/gold]: deal it twice.
AURORAMOD-AURORA_COMMAND_CACHE.title: Command Cache
AURORAMOD-AURORA_COMMAND_CACHE.descripti: The first [gold]Chain[/gold] activation each turn: draw {DrawCount} cards.{IfUpgraded:choose(0):| Gain {BlockOnTrigger:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold] and {HeatGain:diff()} [gold]Heat[/gold].}
AURORAMOD-AURORA_COMMAND_CACHE.smartDesc: The first time you become Chained each turn, draw {DrawCount} cards, gain {BlockOnTrigger} Block and gain {HeatGain} Heat.
AURORAMOD-AURORA_CHAIN_DEFENSE.title: Chain Defense
AURORAMOD-AURORA_CHAIN_DEFENSE.descripti: Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold]. [gold]Chained[/gold]: instead gain {ChainedBlock:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold] and draw {DrawCount} card.
AURORAMOD-AURORA_SENTRY_ARRAY.title: Sentry Array
AURORAMOD-AURORA_SENTRY_ARRAY.descriptio: First successful [gold]Module[/gold] deployment each turn: the new [gold]Module[/gold] gains {EnhancementAmount:diff()} [gold]Enhancement[/gold] and triggers once.
AURORAMOD-AURORA_ASSAULT_REFIT.title: Assault Refit
AURORAMOD-AURORA_ASSAULT_REFIT.descripti: [gold]Deploy[/gold] an [gold]Attack Module[/gold]; on success, trigger all Attack [gold]Modules[/gold] {TriggerCount} times and gain {HeatGain} [gold]Heat[/gold].
AURORAMOD-AURORA_BULWARK_RECONFIGURATION:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold] and [gold]Deploy[/gold] a [gold]Shield Module[/gold].
On success, trigger it once; in [gold]Cold[/gold], trigger it again.
AURORAMOD-AURORA_MODULE_ROTATION.title: Module Rotation
AURORAMOD-AURORA_MODULE_ROTATION.descrip: Choose a [gold]Module[/gold]: [gold]Rotate[/gold] its type and keep its [gold]Enhancement[/gold].{IfUpgraded:choose(0):| Trigger it once.} Draw {DrawCount} card.
AURORAMOD-AURORA_THERMAL_INFUSION.title: Thermal Infusion
AURORAMOD-AURORA_THERMAL_INFUSION.descri:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
With a [gold]Module[/gold]: all [gold]Modules[/gold] gain {EnhancementAmount} [gold]Enhancement[/gold] and you gain {HeatGain} [gold]Heat[/gold].
AURORAMOD-AURORA_FORMATION_ASSAULT.title: Formation Assault
AURORAMOD-AURORA_FORMATION_ASSAULT.descr:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage, plus {DamagePerModule} per deployed [gold]Module[/gold].
With both types: [gold]Vent[/gold] {VentAmount} [gold]Heat[/gold] afterward.
AURORAMOD-AURORA_THERMAL_ROUTING.title: Thermal Routing
AURORAMOD-AURORA_THERMAL_ROUTING.descrip: At turn start, [gold]Cold / Warm / Overload[/gold]: gain 4 [gold]Block[/gold] / draw 1 / gain 1 Energy and 1 [gold]Heat[/gold].
AURORAMOD-AURORA_OVERCLOCK.title: Overclock
AURORAMOD-AURORA_OVERCLOCK.description:
Gain 1 [gold]Overclock[/gold].
Pending [gold]Overheat[/gold] in [gold]Overload[/gold]: Attacks gain +75% final damage per stack.
On resolution, lose 2 [gold]Max HP[/gold] per stack instead; if you cannot pay in full, take the Overheat damage.
AURORAMOD-AURORA_BURIAL_FURNACE.title: Burial Furnace
AURORAMOD-AURORA_LIMIT_FRACTURE.title: Limit Fracture
AURORAMOD-AURORA_LIMIT_FRACTURE.descript:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage, plus {HpScaling} per HP actually lost this combat to your cards or [gold]Overheat[/gold] (max +{RiskBonusCap:diff()}).
Gain {HeatPower} [gold]Heat[/gold].
AURORAMOD-AURORA_ASHEN_REKINDLING.title: Ashen Rekindling
AURORAMOD-AURORA_ASHEN_REKINDLING.descri:
Gain 1 [gold]Ashen Rekindling[/gold].
If your card or [gold]Overheat[/gold] would kill you, consume 1 to stay at 1 HP and gain 2 Energy (next turn outside your action phase).
AURORAMOD-AURORA_SCORCHED_EARTH_STORM.de:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies.
[gold]Overload[/gold]: deal it twice.
Gain {HeatPower} [gold]Heat[/gold]; if this newly locks [gold]Overheat[/gold], trigger it immediately, then deal it once more if you survive.
AURORAMOD-AURORA_SEVER_IN_ONE_STROKE.des: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage, plus {PerMomentum:diff()} per [gold]Momentum[/gold]. Then clear all [gold]Momentum[/gold].
AURORAMOD-AURORA_MOONLESS_BLADE.title: Moonless Blade
AURORAMOD-AURORA_MOONLESS_BLADE.descript: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage, plus {PerMomentum:diff()} per [gold]Momentum[/gold] (counting up to {MomentumCap}).
AURORAMOD-AURORA_MOMENTUM_AMPLIFIER.desc: Gain {BaseGain} [gold]Momentum[/gold], plus 1 per Momentum you had when played (max +{BonusCap}).
AURORAMOD-AURORA_AUTONOMOUS_ARSENAL.desc: End of turn, if [gold]Module slots[/gold] are full: trigger all [gold]Modules[/gold] once more and gain 1 [gold]Heat[/gold].
AURORAMOD-AURORA_ADAPTIVE_CHASSIS.title: Adaptive Chassis
AURORAMOD-AURORA_ADAPTIVE_CHASSIS.descri: First {MaxUses} [gold]Module[/gold] rotations or full-slot replacements each turn: the resulting [gold]Module[/gold] gains 3 [gold]Enhancement[/gold] and triggers once.
AURORAMOD-AURORA_ARRAY_UNIFICATION.title: Array Unification
AURORAMOD-AURORA_ARRAY_UNIFICATION.descr: Choose Attack or Shield. [gold]Rotate[/gold] all [gold]Modules[/gold] to that type, keep their [gold]Enhancement[/gold], and trigger them twice.
AURORAMOD-AURORA_ANNIHILATION_COMMAND.de: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage; with at least 6 cards manually played this turn, deal it {HitCount} times instead.
AURORAMOD-AURORA_CLOSED_LOOP_DEFENSE.des:
Gain {Block} [gold]Block[/gold], plus {PerCard:diff()} per card manually played this turn (max 6 cards).
At least 6: [gold]Vent[/gold] {VentMax} [gold]Heat[/gold].
AURORAMOD-AURORA_COMMAND_RECHARGE.title: Command Recharge
AURORAMOD-AURORA_COMMAND_RECHARGE.descri:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
3+ cards manually played this turn: draw 1 and gain 1 Energy; 6+: draw 2 and gain 2 instead.
On [gold]Chain[/gold] activation, [gold]Cold / Warm / Overload[/gold]: gain 4 [gold]Momentum[/gold] / give the least-enhanced [gold]Module[/gold] 2 [gold]Enhancement[/gold] / trigger all [gold]Modules[/gold] once.
AURORAMOD-AURORA_MOMENTUM_RESONANCE.desc: Turn start: if below {Threshold} [gold]Momentum[/gold], gain {MomentumGain}; otherwise draw {DrawCount} cards.
AURORAMOD-AURORA_MOMENTUM_BULWARK.title: Momentum Bulwark
AURORAMOD-AURORA_MOMENTUM_BULWARK.descri:
Clear all [gold]Momentum[/gold]. Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold], plus 2 per Momentum cleared.
At least 8 cleared: draw 2 cards.
AURORAMOD-AURORA_DISMANTLING_SLASH.title: Dismantling Slash
AURORAMOD-AURORA_DISMANTLING_SLASH.descr:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
You may remove a [gold]Module[/gold]: instead deal {RemoveDamage:diff()}, plus 5 per [gold]Enhancement[/gold] it had.
AURORAMOD-AURORA_FOCUSED_MATRIX.title: Focused Matrix
AURORAMOD-AURORA_FOCUSED_MATRIX.descript:
Choose a [gold]Module[/gold].
[gold]Enhancement[/gold] = your [gold]Module[/gold] count{IfUpgraded:choose(0):| + 1}; triggers = your Module count + 1.
AURORAMOD-AURORA_SEQUENCE_CUTOFF.title: Sequence Cutoff
AURORAMOD-AURORA_SEQUENCE_CUTOFF.descrip: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. [gold]Chained[/gold]: deal {Damage:diff()} damage again. Then [gold]Vent[/gold] all [gold]Heat[/gold].
AURORAMOD-AURORA_INFINITE_CALCULATION.de: Draw to {Target} cards in [gold]hand[/gold] ([gold]Chained[/gold]: {ChainedTarget}); gain 1 [gold]Heat[/gold] per card actually drawn.
AURORAMOD-AURORA_REACTOR_TEMPERING.title: Reactor Tempering
AURORAMOD-AURORA_ARRAY_EXECUTION.title: Array Execution
AURORAMOD-AURORA_ARRAY_EXECUTION.descrip:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
[gold]Chained[/gold] with full [gold]Module slots[/gold]: instead deal {EmpoweredDamage:diff()}, trigger all [gold]Modules[/gold] once, and gain 2 [gold]Heat[/gold].
AURORAMOD-AURORA_MOMENTUM_INFUSION.title: Momentum Infusion
AURORAMOD-AURORA_MOMENTUM_INFUSION.descr:
Spend up to {MaxMomentumSpent} [gold]Momentum[/gold]. For every 3 spent, give all [gold]Modules[/gold] 1 [gold]Enhancement[/gold].
Trigger all [gold]Modules[/gold] once.
AURORAMOD-AURORA_THERMAL_BULWARK_RELAY.d: Target ally gains {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold]. [gold]Vent[/gold] 4 [gold]Heat[/gold]; that ally gains 2 more [gold]Block[/gold] per Heat actually Vented.
AURORAMOD-AURORA_TACTICAL_RELAY.title: Tactical Relay
AURORAMOD-AURORA_TACTICAL_RELAY.descript:
Target ally draws 1 card and gains 1 Energy.
[gold]Chained[/gold]: they draw 2 instead; you gain 2 [gold]Heat[/gold].
AURORAMOD-AURORA_ARMOR_SLAM.title: Armor Slam
AURORAMOD-AURORA_ARMOR_SLAM.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. Damage is equal to your current [gold]Block[/gold].
AURORAMOD-AURORA_REDUNDANT_PLATING.title: Redundant Plating
AURORAMOD-AURORA_REDUNDANT_PLATING.descr: At the start of your turn, retain half of your [gold]Block[/gold].
AURORAMOD-AURORA_VENTED_EDGE.title: Vented Edge
AURORAMOD-AURORA_VENTED_EDGE.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. Every {PerStacks} [gold]Momentum[/gold] increases the damage by {PerBonus}, up to {MaxBonus}.
